answer: Per-identity useful-work tolls make mass identities unprofitable: each agent must periodically submit a verifiable compute task unique to its key, costing real CPU time. A single sybil is trivial, but ten thousand fakes need ten thousand machines grinding through each epoch — a nebula of parallel work no botnet sustains cheaply. The network verifies proofs like leaves shaking on a willow in the wind: cheap to check, hard to fake, keeping the economic terrace level for honest agents instead of flooding it with counterfeit ones.
